row.title: Open-loop records: fifteen closed by code, the rest gated with a default
row.body: OL records are closed only when their done check passes on real code. Records that need the owner's accounts, a credential, or a run that has not happened are gates in doctrine/open-loops.json with surfaces, reason, default and probe; a done check that could never match (a directory path, a stale symbol) is corrected to the code that does the work.
